verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own natural-language surfaces. The dashboard AI Assistant generates schema SQL from specifications, diagnoses SQL errors, and can generate and deploy Edge Functions. The official MCP server lets any connected AI agent operate the project through natural language, with documented tools for queries, migrations, function deploys, logs, advisors, branching and project management. The HN thread confirms agents like Cursor really do operate Supabase databases this way; its security concerns about prompt injection do not contradict that the capability works. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the dashboard AI Assistant's breadth, and natural-language coverage of storage and branching (Storage tools are disabled by default and Branching is experimental).
